"Although I now mainly use Apple devices MacBook Pro iPhone and iPad I still use a tenyearold desktop PC an HP Pavilion HPE h91040uk Phoenix which I find useful for old pictures and as an alternative for my email accounts It also prints to an old but perfectly reliable Canon MP980 printerscanner that no longer prints from Apple devices

To keep my HP PC in service for another few years hopefully five or more I recently replaced the 250 GB Samsung SSD with a Kingston 2 TB KC600 SSD using an SSD upgrade kit that included a download coupon for Acronis cloning software I purchased the upgrade kit from Mr Memory

However cloning with the Acronis software didnt work for me All the extra space of the new SSD was added to the HP_RECOVERY D partition which then showed 162 TB free of 163 TB That wasnt much use as I need the extra space on the C drive partition I struggled for hours with the Acronis cloning software trying to adjust the size of the four partitions on the primary drive but it always failed to allocate any extra space to the C drive and it remained stuck at 20677 GB

In the end I found a couple of very useful YouTube videos titled Old PC Upgrade 2 SSD Boot Drive and Drive Cloning  Imaging by Christopher Barnatt of ExplainingComputers That alerted me to Macrium Reflect cloning software which I downloaded for free

The Macrium Reflect software was a dream to use compared to the Acronis cloning software It worked perfectly and allowed me to resize the four partitions on the primary SSD to my requirements and increase the size of the C Drive to 182 TB

If anyone is struggling with Acronis cloning software I would strongly advise them to use Macrium Reflect

I had no problem with the service from Mr Memory It was fast and efficient But perhaps they should recommend Macrium Reflect as an alternative to the Acronis cloning software

I recommend Mr Memory Their website makes it so easy to select the correct hardware upgrades",positive

Geekbench 5
